test_title: PYST 24: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits fourth to the left of C. P sits fourth to the right of B. Only two people sit between C and B when counted from the left of C. E is not an immediate neighbour of P or B. F is not an immediate neighbour of P. Who sits third to the right of Q?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. A sits fourth to the left of C.

2. P sits fourth to the right of B.

3. Only two people sit between C and B when counted from the left of C.

4. E is not an immediate neighbour of P or B.

5. F is not an immediate neighbour of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e494e6deb8673759db44930f5953ad25e3fa452021fef0e8f00453f809022532.png] 

Q, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71988310697d247244baa89b0a00725160048934d58901a453eab024c5b77793.png] 

Thus, F sits third to the right of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
